conflationGuard: Paper A is mandatory qualifying (50 marks, 50% qualifying score). Paper B determines final merit (100 marks). Stage 3 is 30 WPM typing in Punjabi & English.

qualifying_punjabi_paper_a.title: ਲਾਜ਼ਮੀ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਯੋਗਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ (Paper A - 50 ਅੰਕ)
subtopics: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਅੱਖਰ, ਸਵਰ, ਵਿਅੰਜਨ ਅਤੇ ਲਗਾਂ-ਮਾਤਰਾਂ
ਸ਼ਬਦ ਭੇਦ: ਨਾਵ, ਪੜਨਾਂਵ, ਵਿਸ਼ੇਸ਼ਣ, ਕਿਰਿਆ

general_knowledge_paper_b.title: General Knowledge & Current Affairs (30 Marks)
subtopics: Current Affairs (National & International - last 6 to 12 months)
History & Culture of Punjab (Sikh Gurus, Anglo-Sikh Wars, Freedom Struggle in Punjab)
Geography of Punjab (Rivers, Climate, Soil, Crops, Districts)
Indian Polity & Constitution (Basic features, Articles, Preamble, Fundamental Rights)
Indian Economy, Agriculture and Development Schemes

computer_it.title: Computer and IT Knowledge (20 Marks)
subtopics: Basics of Computers (Hardware, Software, Operating Systems)
MS Word, MS Excel (Formulas, Functions, Charts) and MS PowerPoint
Internet Basics, Search Engines, Web Browsers and Email Protocols
Cyber Security, Viruses, Malware, Phishing and Firewalls
Networking Basics (LAN, WAN, IP addresses, DNS)

reasoning_math.title: Mental Ability & Reasoning (15 Marks)
subtopics: Number and Letter Series, Analogy, Classification
Blood Relations and Direction Sense Test

reasoning_math.title: Numerical Skills / Mathematics (15 Marks)
subtopics: Averages and Basic Mensuration (2D Areas & Perimeters)
